hints.title: Two-Pointer Pairing
hints.text: Pair the smallest remaining element nums[i] with the largest remaining element nums[n - 1 - i].

hints.title: Minimum Average
hints.text: Find the minimum value of (nums[i] + nums[n - 1 - i]) / 2.0 across all i from 0 to n / 2 - 1.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly searching for min and max elements in unsorted list takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond the in-place sort.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort the array and apply two pointers opposite endpoints.
